Seven review threads, zero unresolved. The CodeRabbit README:464 thread is resolved with the disposition that it was pre-existing #3790 wording.

The change adds a bounded artifact-index poll before each checkpoint fetch in release.yml: six attempts at 2/4/8/16/32s, a guarded read with an empty fallback, and a terminal ::error:: plus exit 1. Both checkpoint waits sit strictly before their fetches and are pinned to the same ARTIFACT_NAME the following download uses.

The fetch binding is the repair that makes the identity true: both checkpoint fetches pass github-token, repository and run-id to the pinned download-artifact, so they resolve the name through the REST findBy path the wait polls. Without it the wait could pass while the by-name download used a different listing, and the post-observation case runs after the irreversible upload.
docs/release/README.md now states the sha256:<64 hex> form at both the example and Canonical Path step 2, matching what release.yml:236 parses, so a bare digest can no longer be pasted in silently.

Receipts: the direct-floor receipts were regenerated at the last content commit (13565beac) and committed byte-identical at b2c3614cd; nothing under crates/ changed afterwards, so pregate passes at this head and the projection is 69969274.
